data.description:
## Description
**What**: Complete the standalone documentation addenda (SC8 doc portion), the CLAUDE.md / contracts-index validation-signal references (SC10), and deploy mutation-testing.yml to the host DSO repo to prove the dogfooding loop live (SC11).
**Why**: Makes the surface discoverable, seals bash out of scope in the durable docs, and proves the workflow fires on the very PRs that ship it.
**Scope**:
- IN: behavioral-testing-standard.md Tier-3 addendum naming supported stacks + bash scope-seal with 411b reference; scope decision note in mutation-testing-findings.md; CI-INTEGRATION.md documentation of parallel-job semantics, per-stack timeout handling, ALL_STACKS_TIMEOUT, and TOOL_INSTALL_FAILED; reviewer-assertion guidance so code-reviewer-test-quality flags bash-mutation additions as a scope violation; CLAUDE.md Quick Reference entry for mutation-testing.yml; contracts-index listing for mutation-testing-findings.md (both linking 411b); deploy mutation-testing.yml to host .github/workflows/ immediately after draft-1 so that draft-2..draft-7 story PRs become the dogfooding PRs that trigger a successful run with a posted MUTATION_TESTING_FINDINGS_ comment.
- OUT: the in-workflow scope-seal header (draft-1).
**Forward-deployment ordering**: the host-repo workflow deployment slice is sequenced immediately after draft-1; the SC8 doc addenda and SC10 references are completed in the later slice; live-run verification gates at sprint Phase I.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, mutation-testing.yml is deployed to the host repo's .github/workflows/ immediately after draft-1 so that subsequent 411b story PRs (draft-2..draft-7) act as the dogfooding PRs, and at least one such 411b story PR has a posted comment containing the MUTATION_TESTING_FINDINGS_ marker from a successful workflow run ← Satisfies: sc-11
- When this story is complete, behavioral-testing-standard.md contains a Tier-3 addendum naming the supported stacks and the bash scope-seal with the 411b epic reference, and mutation-testing-findings.md notes the scope decision ← Satisfies: sc-8
- When this story is complete, CI-INTEGRATION.md documents mutation-testing parallel-job semantics, per-stack timeout handling, ALL_STACKS_TIMEOUT behavior, and the TOOL_INSTALL_FAILED annotation, and the test-quality reviewer guidance flags any proposed bash-mutation-tooling addition as a scope violation ← Satisfies: sc-8
- When this story is complete, CLAUDE.md Quick Reference references mutation-testing.yml as the project's mutation-testing surface and plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ index lists mutation-testing-findings.md, both linking to the 411b epic ← Satisfies: sc-10
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for any new or modified logic, and the live dogfooding run is verified against the real GitHub Actions environment rather than a local-only simulation ← Satisfies: sc-11

## Considerations

- [Live-verification] SC11 is a LIVE-VERIFIED dogfooding check: verification must observe a real GHA run on a real 411b story PR, not a local simulation; gate at sprint Phase I.
- [Sequencing/Self-defeat] SC11 requires >=1 411b story PR to trigger the deployed workflow and post the MUTATION_TESTING_FINDINGS_ marker. Land the host-repo .github/workflows/mutation-testing.yml deployment immediately after draft-1 so draft-2..draft-7 story PRs become the dogfooding PRs; keep SC8 doc addenda + SC10 references in the later slice; live-run verification gates at sprint Phase I.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want the scope-seal documentation, validation-signal references, and host-repo dogfooding deployment completed, so that mutation testing is discoverable, scope-sealed, and proven live on its own PRs.
